$:s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909")
    .gain(1.3)
    .compressor(0.85)       // punch max
    .attack(0.001)
  
$:s("~ hh*8 ~ hh*4").bank("Rolandr8").gain(0.5)
  
$:s("oh").bank("RolandTR909").degradeBy(0.2)
  .gain(0.7)
  .room(0.8)
  .delay(0.25)
  .delaytime(0.75)
  .every(8, fast(1))

$:n("0 5 7 0") .scale("C2 minor")    
    .s("gm_lead_8_bass_lead")
    .slow(4) // 1 note par mesure
    .lpf(300)
    .dist(0.6)        // distorsion = attaque + grain
    .attack(0.01)     // attaque ultra-rapide
    .release(0.5)
    .gain(0.9)

$:n("<[0,3,7] [5,8,0] [7,10,2] [0,3,7]>").fast(4)
    .scale("C4 minor")
    .s("gm_flute")
    .room(0.6)
    .delay(0.3)
    .delaytime(0.25)
    .gain(0.6)
    .lpf(perlin.range(800, 2500))  // filtre qui bouge doucement

  $:n("0 2 4 <3 5> ~ [7 5]").scale("C3 minor")
    .s("triangle")
    .room(0.4)
    .delay(0.25)
    .delaytime(1.0)
    .gain(0.7)

$:n("0 1 2 3 4 5").s("vox")  
    .slow(12) 
    .room(0.4)
    .delay(0.2)
    .gain(1.3)
    .every(16, x => x)
    .sometimes(x => x.chop(4))
    .sometimes(x => x.rev()) 
    .speed((0.8, 1)).degradeBy(.1)
